mapper.sql: report_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, report_type, content, based_on_evidence, based_on_reconciliations, generated_at, supersedes_report_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relationship_report (report_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, report_type, content, based_on_evidence, based_on_reconciliations, generated_at, supersedes_report_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{operatingCaseId}, #{journeyId}, #{reportType}, #{content}, #{basedOnEvidence, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{basedOnReconciliations, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{generatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{supersedesReportId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM relationship_report WHERE operating_case_id = #{operatingCaseId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC
SELECT FROM relationship_report WHERE journey_id = #{journeyId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
